answer: Like frost crystallizing across a barren tundra, decentralized trust forms through dense peer validation rather than an ivory tower. To resist Sybil swarms, our economy employs reciprocal transitive staking: every agent must be vouched for through bonded attestations. A fleeting sparrow cannot spawn infinite masks; forging identities demands exponentially compounding collateral, ensuring attacker costs scale superlinearly to paralyze fraud.
